Model 2, in stark contrast, shows almost no emotional expression. The delivery is monotonous and flat, completely failing to convey the requested fear. The speech sounds robotic and devoid of any emotional coloring. The phrase 'I am so scared' is delivered with the same emotional weight as a weather report, making it entirely unconvincing.
